credential_custody.custody_statement: Repository tokens and provider keys remain on the customer-controlled host and are not included in this evidence.

redaction.redaction_statement: This evidence contains only redacted labels, status values, counts, limitation categories, and operator notes approved for sharing.

workflow_lanes.label: Token or installation setup
workflow_lanes.summary: Operator configures least-privilege repository access locally.

workflow_lanes.label: Repository access validation
workflow_lanes.summary: Operator validates access without exporting token material.

workflow_lanes.label: Private repository import
workflow_lanes.summary: Run import in the customer-controlled environment and record count-only results.

workflow_lanes.label: Decision review
workflow_lanes.summary: Record candidate and accepted decision counts only.

workflow_lanes.label: Why-search validation
workflow_lanes.summary: Record grounded/insufficient-evidence outcomes without raw answers.

workflow_lanes.label: Drift review
workflow_lanes.summary: Record drift state and false-positive notes without raw private artifacts.

workflow_lanes.label: Release and handoff evidence
workflow_lanes.summary: Attach sanitized release/readiness/handoff/audit evidence when approved.

limitations: This committed sample is not private-repository proof.
Actual private-repository evidence must be generated locally or in the customer-controlled environment.
Raw private source content, issue text, pull-request text, token material, and provider keys are intentionally excluded.
recommended_next_actions: Run the private-repository pilot in the customer-controlled environment.
Fill count-only outcomes after operator review.
Run verify_private_repo_pilot_evidence.py before sharing sanitized evidence.

operator_review.review_statement: A human operator must confirm redaction and customer approval before this evidence is used in a customer handoff.
